source.author: stat
source.text: ast ubi prona dies, longos super aequora fines exigit atque ingens medio natat umbra profundo, interiore sinu frangentia litora curvat Taenaros, expositos non audax scandere fluctus, illic Aegaeo Neptunus gurgite fessos in portum deducit equos, prior haurit harenas ungula, postremi solvuntur in aequora pisces, hoc, ut fama, loco pallentes devius umbras trames agit nigrique Iovis vacua atria ditat mortibus.
source.text_original: ast ubi prona dies, longos super aequora fines / exigit atque ingens medio natat umbra profundo, / interiore sinu frangentia litora curvat / Taenaros, expositos non audax scandere fluctus, / illic Aegaeo Neptunus gurgite fessos / in portum deducit equos, prior haurit harenas / ungula, postremi solvuntur in aequora pisces, / hoc, ut fama, loco pallentes devius umbras / trames agit nigrique Iovis vacua atria ditat / mortibus.
source.text_english: But when the day slopes downward, drawing out long reaches over the seas, and a huge shadow swims in the midst of the deep, Taenaros bends its shore, curving the inner bay where the breakers fall, and dares not climb the exposed waves; there Neptune, in the Aegean flood, leads his weary horses into port, the foremost hoof first drinks the sands, the last are loosed into the waters like fish. In this place, so runs the tale, a wandering path drives the pale shades and enriches the empty halls of dark Jupiter with the dead.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_original: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat / manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, / siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_english: Then Alcimede was bringing sacred rites to Tartarean Jove and to the Stygian spirits, as an added support for her mighty son, if from the summoned shades she might learn anything better in advance.
